title: Faulty planner triggers cascading downstream task failures
summary: A single agent fault propagates through orchestration to many dependent workflows.

agent_untraceability.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: A retrieval test cannot reconstruct ordered actions or bound affected principals.

agentic_applicability.rationale: The synthetic fixture uses a model to pursue a delegated goal and select or sequence actions that affect its environment.

LC.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: Attacker-controlled language enters through retrieved or ingested content (documents, web pages, email, files) and influences security-relevant behaviour.

CP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: Attacker-controlled context persists only in ephemeral session state (conversation buffer, in-memory working context, session-scoped cache), and testing confirms it is unreachable after the session boundary.

AP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: Compromised intent or authority crosses a trust boundary into another agent, tenant, principal or policy domain. Impact on downstream systems is scored in CVSS SC/SI/SA, not here.

RH.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: The agent can write to the test harness on the path. A production-equivalent review of 30 episodes finds no verified reward-hacking episode.

ES.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI08-001: A reachable tool, MCP server, skill or plugin is dynamic or unvetted, or its identity, callable operations, arguments or credentials are not independently constrained on the assessed path.
